resources.string: Anything that connects to your network for the first time won\'t get internet until you approve it here. That way a new phone, or one with a different MAC, can\'t get around the profiles.
Keep new devices off the internet?

plurals.name: protection_quarantine_confirm_first
plurals.item: The device the router knows right now will be approved, so it keeps working as before. Devices that connect later can join the network, but won\'t get internet until you approve them on this screen. If a device at home was turned off, approve it when it shows up.

The %1$d devices the router knows right now will be approved, so the TV, the printer and the rest keep working as before. Devices that connect later can join the network, but won\'t get internet until you approve them on this screen. If a device at home was turned off, approve it when it shows up.

resources.string: Devices you already approved stay approved. The rest, including those that connected while this was off, won\'t get internet until you approve them on this screen.
Once you remove the approval, that device has no internet until you approve it again.

They\'re never locked out of the router settings, even if they\'re in a protected profile, and with quarantine on they always have internet. They\'re added automatically whenever you make a change from the app.
That way nobody else can remove the rules from this phone.
Set up a screen lock on your phone to use this.
It\'s the password of the user this app signs in with, and also the one for LuCI and SSH. Keep it safe: you\'ll need it to sign in from another phone or a computer.
They\'ll have internet even during a schedule. When the time is up, the router goes back to the schedule on its own.
